hook: A bear, a bunny and a snail march to the steady beat while the class pats along and freezes when the music stops. Then build rhythms from animal cards and clap them back.
outcome: Keep a steady beat at different speeds, tell the beat from the rhythm, and read, clap and create four-beat patterns with long sounds, short sounds and rests
sources: Illustrations generated with Google Gemini, edited for Curio Class
Original march tune; all sound synthesized in the browser
Narration generated with Qwen3-TTS (Apache 2.0), cloning a Google Gemini text-to-speech voice
